title: Heavy third-party script load
summary: The homepage loads 56 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
problem: The homepage loads 56 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 inline and 15 external <script> tags, 300 KB of HTML.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
